materials.title: What we are made of
materials.parotaText: With deep grains and an untamed character. We select the finest Parota wood from Jalisco to create pieces that breathe the strength of our land.
materials.ironText: Where fire becomes art. Our cast iron handles are handcrafted by Mexican artisans, creating unique and unrepeatable pieces.
materials.clayText: Shaped by history. Each piece is born from Chiapas clay, transformed by the hands and brushes of indigenous women who express their worldview in every stroke.
materials.metalText: A flower that never fades. This emblematic design pays tribute to the City of Roses (Guadalajara), capturing the delicacy of its roses in locally forged metal.
